description: This file implements API key management services including creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, and validation, with permission checks and integration with a database.

methods.name: validatePermissions
methods.description: Validates that requested permissions are allowed for API keys, including platform-specific feature checks and user permission validation.

methods.name: getAllApiKeysByOrganization
methods.description: Retrieves all API keys associated with a specific organization, across all workspaces.

methods.name: getAllApiKeys
methods.description: Retrieves API keys for a workspace, filtered based on user permissions if not an admin.

methods.name: getApiKey
methods.description: Fetches a specific API key by its key string.

methods.name: getApiKeyById
methods.description: Fetches a specific API key by its ID.

methods.name: createApiKey
methods.description: Creates a new API key after validating permissions, then returns all API keys for the user.

methods.name: updateApiKey
methods.description: Updates an existing API key's name and permissions after validation, then returns all API keys for the user.

methods.name: deleteApiKey
methods.description: Deletes an API key by ID and workspace ID.

methods.name: verifyApiKey
methods.description: Verifies if an API key exists and is authorized.
